entities.summary: Mauricio Montalvo Samaniego is an Ecuadorean lawyer, diplomat and university professor. He was Minister of Foreign Affairs of Ecuador, holds a LL.M. from Harvard Law School and was Ambassador to the United Nations in Geneva, to Australia and to the Organization of American States (OAS) in Washington DC. Currently, he is the Ambassador of Ecuador to South Africa.
